notes.title: Darwake @ Major European Live Events!
notes.content:
Hello brave dreamlings of the Darwake community! 🖤

We're beyond excited (and maybe a bit terrified) to reveal that Darwake will be haunting some of the most anticipated live events of the year! This is an extraordinary opportunity for us to connect face-to-face, discuss the game, and strengthen our eerie community. We value your support and feedback immensely, and there's no better way to celebrate our journey than by meeting you all in person!

Here's where our dark journey will take us:

🎮 Gamescom
When: August 20-25, 2024
Where: Cologne, Germany

🎨 WonderCon Italy
When: October 4-6, 2024
Where: Angri, Italy

🎮 Milan Games Week
When: November 22-24, 2024
Where: Milan, Italy

If you're attending any of these events, make sure to drop by our haunted booth. Let's create unforgettable memories together, talk about the game, and show the world the power of the Darwake community! Your passion and enthusiasm inspire us to delve even deeper into the shadows, and we can't wait to share all the spine-chilling updates we have in store.

And this... Is just the beginning 🦉 

So make sure to stay tuned for more details and sneak peeks as we add more to our road ahead because it's going to be a hell of a ride! Thank you for being the heart and soul of Darwake! Let's make 2024 an epic (and eerie) year for our community!

See you there... if you dare! 💬✨

notes.title: Localization Out Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy, brave dreamlings! 🌙

We are beyond excited to announce that the Darwake Demo has been localized into 11 languages and is now available on Steam. This effort represents also our heartfelt promise to you that these 11 languages will be included in the full game upon its release:

- Brazilian Portuguese
- French
- German
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Russian
- Spanish
- Traditional/Simplified Chinese
- Ukrainian

We chose these languages based on the overwhelming number of requests we've received and the data we've gathered through Steam. Each language represents a voice from our community, and we’ve worked tirelessly to honor your requests. If your language isn’t included yet, know that it’s not forgotten. Adding these languages was a huge effort, both technically and artistically and, even if we are not 100% certain, we hope to expand further in the future.

Our translators have worked hard to ensure everything is more than perfect. However, if you notice any issues or areas for improvement, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server. Your feedback is invaluable and helps us create a better experience for everyone. We are grateful for your insights and ideas – you are the real reason we do what we do, so don’t keep your thoughts to yourself. We’re always eager to hear from you!

Your support and engagement fuel the flickering flame of Darwake’s future. Each piece of feedback, each suggestion, helps us shape a world that lives up to your dreams (or nightmares?).

Fair winds and dark dreams, fellow travelers. Your journey in Darwake is just beginning, and we are honored to have you with us on this adventure.

With deepest gratitude,
The Darwake Team 🎩

notes.title: Darwake Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy, brave adventurers of the digital realm! 

Today, amidst the swirling mists of uncertainty, we stand at the threshold of a the thrilling first taste of the world of Darwake! 
Our team brims with excitement as we unveil this tantalizing taste of what's to come, and rest assured, there's much more magic brewing in our cauldron.

But hold onto your hats, dear travelers! Your adventure has only just begun. We yearn for your insights and discoveries! Feel free to share your thoughts and uncover any lurking gremlins in our Steam Community and Discord Channel. 

Your voices resonate in the void, and we're eager to heed your call! 

And remember, fellow dreamlings, your support fuels the flickering flame of Darwake's future... 
So, if you dare, bestow upon us the honor of a wishlist on Steam! Your gesture is more than a mere click; it's a spark of possibility in the darkness!
